moments.title: Halloween on a Saturday
moments.blurb: Halloween 2026 falls on a Saturday, October 31st, making it the first Saturday Halloween in several years and ideal for extended celebrations.

source.l: Time and Date / Vertex AI Search

angles.name: Weekend Halloween
angles.copy: Get ready for the ultimate Halloween weekend! Saturday, October 31st means extra time for spooky celebrations, epic costumes, and all the treats. What are your plans for the biggest party night of the year?

angles.name: Best Halloween Yet
angles.copy: A Saturday Halloween? Yes, please! October 31st is set to be HUGE this year. No school night worries, just pure, unadulterated spooky fun. Are you going all out?

moments.title: Bonfire Night is Next Week
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating the Gunpowder Plot, is celebrated on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays planned across the UK for the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Guy Fawkes Night
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is just around the corner. Are you heading to a local display or hosting your own fireworks spectacular?

angles.name: Fireworks Prep
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is next Thursday, November 5th! Time to start thinking about those sparklers, toffee apples, and where you'll catch the best fireworks. What's your favourite part of Guy Fawkes Night?

moments.title: GBBO Dessert Week Recap
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off's Dessert Week (Week 5) saw Yannis eliminated and Connie named Star Baker, with judges Paul Hollywood and Nigella Lawson overseeing self-saucing puddings and retro desserts.

angles.name: Bake Off Dessert Drama
angles.copy: Dessert Week in the Bake Off tent was a rollercoaster! Yannis sadly left, but Connie shone as Star Baker. What was your favourite retro pudding from Tuesday's show?

angles.name: Nigella's Technical
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson's technical challenge always delivers! Were you impressed by the bakers' attempts at the British classic in Dessert Week on #GBBO? We're still craving those self-saucing puddings!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity Trailer Drops

angles.name: Jungle Countdown

angles.name: Ant & Dec's Return
angles.copy: It's not Christmas without it! The I'm A Celebrity trailer confirms Ant & Dec's return, with the series likely kicking off mid-November. The rumours are flying – who's on your dream line-up?

moments.title: Taylor Swift Dominates Singles Chart

angles.name: New No.1 Hit
angles.copy: Another week, another chart-topping hit for Taylor Swift! 'Patient Zero' is officially the UK's number one single. Have you been streaming her new music?
